answer: Tracking each agent identity like a comet means scoring its credential graph against a shared conjunction catalog, so a lone sybil with thin corroboration shows low collision probability. Every attestation exchange emits a pulse that updates that catalog, and an attacker must sustain costly independent corroboration across many accounts to raise any single score. The anchor is a bonded stake slashed when trajectories converge, capping attackers at the cost of real collateral while honest agents pay only routine tracking overhead.
